record.one_liner: Enterprise deal management and relationship intelligence CRM platform (Intapp) with a REST API for records, schema, and events.
record.auth_notes: DealCloud issues an API Key (Client ID + secret) from a user's Profile page, which is exchanged via OAuth2 Client Credentials flow at {baseUrl}/api/rest/v1/oauth/token to obtain a bearer token used in the Authorization header.
record.access_notes: API access is not self-serve signup: an admin must enable the 'API' capability for a user group under Admin > User Management before a user can generate an API key from their profile. Publications (event streaming) additionally requires contacting the account manager to have it enabled. No vendor-owned public pricing/signup page was found; DealCloud appears to be sold only to existing enterprise customers.
record.api_breadth_basis: Vendor docs list several distinct resource families (Authentication, User Management, Schema, Data, Backups, Publications, Relationship Intelligence) each with multiple endpoints, plus Python/C# SDKs — more than a narrow single-resource API but not a sprawling 60+ endpoint surface.
record.blocker_notes: A working DealCloud toolkit requires an existing DealCloud customer account where a site admin enables the API capability for the user's group, then the user enables their own API key. There is no public self-serve developer signup outside of an existing paid customer relationship.

evidence.quote: Treat your API key like a password: do not share it or expose it in public code repositories.
Navigate to Admin > User Management, select the relevant user group, go to Capabilities > Site Areas, and enable 'API'.
Get in touch with your account manager to have Publications enabled on your site.
